title: Self-Stigma Is Not a Monolith, but Generic Empathy Is: Persona-Conditioned LLM Support for People Who Use Drugs

bias_targets.methodology: Domain expert evaluation of LLM-generated support responses using rubrics designed to measure stigma-sensitive communication (e.g., voice-preserving language, non-performative empathy) and harmful behavioral patterns like unsignaled crisis routing toward people who use drugs (PWUD).
